raw_text:
BINGO! POTATO CHIPS
INGREDIENTS: POTATO (62.4%), EDIBLE VEGETABLE OIL (PALM OIL & REFINED PALMOLIVE OIL)**, SEASONING (SALT, RED CHILLI POWDER (0.4%), SPICES & CONDIMENTS, SUGAR, ONION POWDER, MAIDA (REFINED WHEAT FLOUR), BLACK SALT, ACIDS, NATURE IDENTICAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES, MILK SOLIDS, FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES, SOY PROTEIN, ACIDITY REGULATORS (MALIC ACID, CITRIC ACID), TARTARIC ACID, GARLIC POWDER AND FLAVOUR ENHANCERS (INS 627, INS 631)).
*TO KNOW THE SPECIFIC TYPE OF OIL USED, MATCH THE SYMBOL ('I' OR 'S') LAST CHARACTER OF BATCH NUMBER WHERE 'I' DENOTES REFINED PALM OIL,
**AS DENOTES REFINED RICE BRAN OIL.
^USED AS FLAVOURING AGENTS.
CONTAINS MILK, WHEAT AND SOY. MAY CONTAIN BARLEY.
DO NOT BUY THE PACK IF FOUND TAMPERED WITH.
STORE IN A COOL, DRY & HYGIENIC PLACE.
PROPRIETARY FOOD - POTATO CHIPS (7.1.1)
